stories.title: CMZoo Giraffe Center Opens TODAY — International Center for Care & Conservation of Giraffe
stories.angle: The International Center for the Care and Conservation of Giraffe officially opens TODAY at 9:30 AM at Cheyenne Mountain Zoo. The $40 million facility features a 12,000 sq ft barn, 11 feeding zones (up from 3), a 25% increase in outdoor giraffe space, and the largest ETFE clear roof covering any animal exhibit in North America. Mayor Yemi Mobolade attends the ribbon cutting. CMZoo Centennial Celebration continues through Sunday. Military Week (50% off military/dependents) runs through Sep 19. Advance tickets at cmzoo.org only.

stories.title: SHEIN Recalls ~963 Spiral Toys — Choking Hazard for Children Under 3
stories.angle: CPSC announced SHEIN Distribution Corporation is recalling about 963 spiral toys because small ball components violate the federal small ball ban for toys intended for children under age 3. The toy features 3, 5, or 7 colored stackable platforms and yellow plastic balls with bear heads. Sold on SHEIN.com September 2025 through May 2026 for $6–$16. Consumers should stop use and contact SHEIN for a full refund. No injuries reported.

stories.title: OKK Rainbow Mystery Squishy Bun Toys Recalled — Water Bead Ingestion Risk
stories.angle: OKK Trading is recalling about 7,200 Rainbow Mystery Squishy Bun Toys (model D08004, translucent pink with glitter and water beads) because water beads inside expand larger than permitted, posing ingestion, choking, and intestinal obstruction hazards. Sold at various third-party stores nationwide, May through August 2026. Consumers should write "RECALLED" on the toy, throw it away, and email recall@okktoys.com for a full refund. No injuries reported.

stories.title: Lontcs Busy Boards Recalled for Lead Paint Violations
stories.angle: SQT LLC recalls Lontcs Busy Boards sold on Amazon (May 2024 – July 2026, ~$31) for violating the federal lead paint ban. Lead exposure is dangerous at any level, especially for young children, and can cause serious developmental harm. Consumers should stop use immediately, destroy the toy by unscrewing its components, write "RECALLED" in permanent marker, and send a photo to Lontcs@163.com for a full refund.
